offence: Breach of Article B1.6.3a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: Car 77 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 80 km/h for this event by 9.5 km/h. In keeping with the Penalty Guidelines, for exceeding the speed limit in the pit lane by 6-15 Km/h the prescribed penalty is a drive through, which we impose.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 77 Pit Lane Speeding
to: The Team Manager, Cadillac Formula 1 Team
